## About Me

::: {style="text-align:left;"}
![](images/jlr_headshot_syr.jpg){width=100px}
:::

Hello and welcome to the course website for PST 315, "Methods of Policy
Analysis and Presentation." I am your instructor,
[Professor Jack Reilly](https://www.maxwell.syr.edu/directory/jack-reilly). You
can find more about me on my [website](https://jacklreilly.github.io), if you are so inclined.

Please take a minute to browse this website, where you will find the course
[overview](overview.qmd), course [logistics](logistics.qmd),
[assignments](assignments/index.qmd), the [guidelines](guidelines/index.qmd)
that show you how to do the work, and campus academic
[policies](policies.qmd).

Finally, if you would like this website and syllabus in an alternate format,
please note that you can download .pdfs or .docxs of any page on the site
simply by clicking the link on the page. You can also download a full copy of
the main syllabus [here](syllabus.qmd).

## Technical Details

This site was built in [Quarto](https://quarto.org) using
[Positron](https://positron.posit.co), and is hosted on
[GitHub Pages](https://docs.github.com/en/pages).
